about: Every configuration field an IronSide bundle carries, in one place.

base.title: base configuration
base.summary: the write-once UICR words: the partition layout, the PSA key slots and the IKG SEED selection

fields.name: format-version
fields.help: format version (default: {default})

fields.name: slot1-size-kb
fields.help: SLOT1 partition size in kB

fields.name: storage-size-kb
fields.help: STORAGE partition size in kB

fields.name: urotstorage-size-kb
fields.help: UROTSTORAGE partition size in kB

fields.name: dfuimage-size-kb
fields.help: DFUIMAGE partition size in kB

fields.name: key-slot-storage-size-bytes
fields.label: key slot storage size
fields.help: PSA key slot storage size in bytes, 1536..42496 (default: 1536, the 8 slots every device has at the top of the fixed 32 kB ROT-RAM). It holds every whole 192 B slot that fits, BYTES / 192 slots. Anything above 1536 is secure RAM reserved above ROT-RAM and must be a multiple of the part's RAM split granule (32 B on the nRF54LM20 and nRF54LV10A, 4096 B on the nRF54L15), so a size is 1536 plus that multiple. The non-secure RAM starts where the storage ends, so an application must be built for the same bundle

fields.name: ikg-seed-select
fields.label: IKG SEED selection
fields.help: IKG SEED entry the device derives its identity from: {ENTRY} (default: auto). auto leaves the selection to provisioning, which selects User SEED when it is Locked and Nordic SEED otherwise. The selected entry must hold a SEED, and provision-user-seed yes refuses nordic. Changing it on a device takes an ERASEALL

fields.name: no-partitions
fields.help: do not write partitions (device requires another source)

fields.name: no-authlock
fields.help: omit the APPROTECTAUTHLOCK marker (bench use only)

fields.name: allow-no-urot
fields.help: allow a configuration without UROT keys (device will not boot)

image.title: image configuration
image.summary: the protected TLV inside the UROT image: DFU triggers, the non-secure watchdog and the power-fail comparator

fields.name: dfu-trigger-gpio
fields.help: GPIO trigger, for example P1.8,low (LEVEL: {LEVEL}, PULL: {PULL})

fields.name: no-dfu-trigger-gpio
fields.help: disable the GPIO trigger

fields.name: dfu-trigger-resetreas
fields.help: reset reason trigger, space or comma separated (R: {R})

fields.name: dfu-trigger-fault
fields.help: boot IronSide DFU on the boot after a non-secure fault, so it can export the fault record

fields.name: no-dfu-trigger-fault
fields.help: disable the fault trigger

fields.name: wdtstart-crv-ms
fields.help: non-secure watchdog timeout in milliseconds (0 disables)

fields.name: wdt-crv
fields.help: exact WDT31 CRV, for tests that assert one

fields.name: pof
fields.help: power-fail comparator threshold, as the raw per-part THRESHOLD code 0..15 from the datasheet; add noevent to suppress the POFWARN event

fields.name: no-pof
fields.help: disable the power-fail comparator

fields.name: board-lfxo
fields.help: LFXO crystal load capacitance in picofarads, e.g. 17, with bypass when an external clock drives LFXO instead of a crystal. UROT does not boot without it. If never set, signing applies the nRF54L DK value 17, with a warning

fields.name: board-hfxo
fields.help: HFXO crystal load capacitance in picofarads. UROT does not boot without it. If never set, signing applies the nRF54L DK value 15, with a warning

fields.name: board-vreg
fields.help: main regulator mode: {MODE}. dcdc needs the DC/DC inductor on the board. UROT does not boot without it. If never set, signing applies the nRF54L DK value dcdc, with a warning

fields.name: authop-revoke-gen
fields.help: revoke AUTHOP generation GEN (0, 1 or 2) and every older one on each device the UROT update reaches, or none. A later release should keep it, and lowering it only warns. Revoking generation 2, the last one, removes every authenticated debug operation from the device permanently

provisioning.title: provisioning configuration
provisioning.summary: the deployment's permanent choices: how the access port closes, and which IKG SEED entries provisioning writes

fields.name: ap-closure
fields.label: access port closure method
fields.help: access port closure method: {METHOD} (default: {default}). The hardware-fixed method is permanent. The authenticated method allows authenticated debug

fields.name: provision-user-seed
fields.label: User SEED provisioning
fields.help: whether provisioning enrolls User SEED: {CHOICE} (default: {default}). no writes no SEED slot and uses the entry the device already has, so provisioning an unseeded device stops before anything is written. yes enrolls User SEED, which is permanent, and leaves Nordic SEED as it is. See the section "User SEED provisioning" in the user guide

gpio-level.holder: the active level of a DFU-entry GPIO trigger, which UROT derives from the stored pull

values.name: no
values.label: no, use the IKG SEED the device already has
